sloka: तं तु राजन्दशग्रीवं प्रविशन्तं निशाचरम् ।सूर्यभानुरिति ख्यातो द्वारपालो न्यवारयत् ।। ७.१४.२५ ॥
transliteration: taṁ tu rājandaśagrīvaṁ praviśantaṁ niśācaram ।sūryabhānuriti khyāto dvārapālo nyavārayat ।। 7.14.25 ॥

translations.english: O King, the doorkeeper known as Suryabhanu obstructed that Dashagriva, the night-wanderer, as he was entering.
